meta_description: Sea Shack is a beach house for rent in Seaside, Florida! This beach house is both quaint and luxurious located on Tupelo Street in Seaside, FL! Making it a short walk from the pool and Seaside's central square.
description_expanded:
Sea Shack | Seaside, FL - Carriage House

128 Tupelo Street, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Sea Shack is a quaint and luxurious guest cottage located on peaceful Tupelo street. This vacation rental home is a quick walk to the adult pool, fitness center, family pool and tennis facility. The idyllic Seaside carriage house is decorated in a coastal luxury style, featuring creamy white walls, rich wood floors and vintage-style appliances in the kitchen.

The living space of Sea Shack is on the first floor and features a flat screen TV, two chairs and a sofa for family time. The kitchen features vintage-style appliances surrounded by creamy white cabinets. The dining area seats five is just off of the kitchen area and is surrounded by windows to provide plenty of natural light. One of your favorite places to spend time is sure to be the spacious, deck area. The guest bedroom is located on the first floor and has a full sized bed. The full bathroom with a single vanity and walk in shower is also located just off the bedroom. The guest bedroom has access to a wonderful sunroom which is perfect for a lazy afternoon reading a book. There is a stairway in the guest bedroom which leads up to the master bedroom.

The master bedroom is accessed by walking through the guest bedroom and up the stairs to the second floor. The cozy master bedroom has a queen sized bed and features a vanity with a sink and drawers and also a private powder room. You will enjoy stepping out on your private balcony, which overlooks the yard. Sea Shack is a perfect home for your Seaside getaway!

**If you need space for a few more people, Sea Shack has a main cottage available for rental . Taste & Sea is a beautiful, three bedroom home that will sleep 6 people and is located in front of the guest cottage.

**Construction noises may be present.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights

Sleeps 4

2 Bedrooms

1 1/2 Baths

920 Square Feet

Lovely Deck Area with Seating

Parking for 1 car in Driveway

First Floor

- Welcoming deck area with seating

- Living area with TV two chairs and a sofa

- Kitchen with brand new vintage-style appliance

- Dining area with seating for 5

- Bedroom with full sized bed (master bedroom and bathroom is accessed through this room)

- Full bath with single vanity and walk in shower

- Washer and dryer

- Sun room

Second Floor

- Master bedroom with queen size bed, tv, and balcony access

Additional

- Can be rented with the main cottage Taste & Sea which is a 3 bedroom home that sleeps 6

- Golf cart rentals are not allowed in Seaside.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional clean charges.

- No smoking home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the No Smoking policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- Seaside Amenity Fees Include: Seaside Parking Pass(1), Wristbands for Beach Access, and Access to the Community Swimming Pools and Tennis Courts.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking

- Except for a $250 cancellation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to arrival date

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
